mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, we are looking at 49 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Area High School. We also have a waning gibbous moon, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Important reminders for today: The City has contracted with Pellitteri for refuse and recycling, so check their app for your schedule. Also, winter parking regulations are now in effect, meaning you must park on the even or odd side of the street depending on the date.

There is plenty to do! Today, visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga is scheduled for November 2, and trivia nights begin November 4 at various local spots.
On October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I after finding his vehicle stopped at an intersection for over 20 minutes.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
